walkthrough:
Factor out $2$ and complete the square for $2x^2 + 12x + 11$:
$$2x^2 + 12x + 11 = 2(x^2 + 6x) + 11 = 2\left[(x + 3)^2 - 9\right] + 11 = 2(x + 3)^2 - 18 + 11 = 2(x + 3)^2 - 7$$
where $a = 3$ and $b = -7$.

hints: Take the negative square root since $x \le -4$ ($x + 3 \le -1 < 0$).
State the inverse function and find its domain from the range of $f$ ($x \ge -5$).
walkthrough:
Set $y = 2(x + 3)^2 - 7$ and isolate the squared term:
$$2(x + 3)^2 = y + 7 \implies (x + 3)^2 = \frac{y + 7}{2}$$

Take square roots, choosing the negative branch because the domain is $x \le -4$ ($x + 3 < 0$):
$$x + 3 = -\sqrt{\frac{y + 7}{2}} \implies x = -\sqrt{\frac{y + 7}{2}} - 3$$

Write the inverse function in terms of $x$:
$$f^{-1}(x) = -\sqrt{\frac{x + 7}{2}} - 3$$

Determine the domain of $f^{-1}$ (the range of $f$ on $x \le -4$):
$$x \le -4 \implies x + 3 \le -1 \implies (x + 3)^2 \ge 1 \implies 2(x + 3)^2 - 7 \ge -5$$
$$\text{Domain of } f^{-1}: \quad x \ge -5 \quad (\text{or } [-5, \infty))$$

hints: Solve $8x^2 - 7 = 193$ for $x$, selecting the root satisfying the domain $x \le -1$.
walkthrough:
Form the composite function $fg(x)$ using the completed square form:
$$fg(x) = 2(g(x) + 3)^2 - 7 = 2(2x - 3 + 3)^2 - 7 = 2(2x)^2 - 7 = 8x^2 - 7$$

Equate to $193$ and solve for $x$:
$$8x^2 - 7 = 193 \implies 8x^2 = 200 \implies x^2 = 25 \implies x = \pm 5$$

Select the valid solution consistent with the domain restriction $x \le k = -1$:
$$x = -5 \quad (\text{rejecting } x = 5 \text{ since } 5 > -1)$$

hints: For $fg$ to be defined, Range($g$) $\subseteq$ Domain($f$).
Set $2k - 3 \le -4$ and solve for the maximum value of $k$.
walkthrough:
For the composite function $fg$ to exist, the range of $g$ must be contained within the domain of $f$:
$$\text{Domain of } f = (-\infty, -4]$$
$$\text{Range of } g \text{ on } x \le k = (-\infty, 2k - 3]$$
$$(-\infty, 2k - 3] \subseteq (-\infty, -4] \implies 2k - 3 \le -4 \implies 2k \le -1 \implies k \le -\frac{1}{2}$$

State the largest possible value of $k$:
$$k = -\frac{1}{2} \quad (\text{or } -0.5)$$
